title: Savory Middle Eastern Labneh Bowl
description: A flavorful and refreshing bowl filled with creamy labneh cheese, topped with savory spices and fresh vegetables. This dish is perfect for a light and satisfying meal.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together olive oil and zatar.
Add chopped cucumber, mint, and scallions to the bowl and toss to combine.
In a small bowl, crumble labneh cheese.
In the bottom of a large bowl, arrange a layer of sliced pita bread.
Spoon the labneh cheese on top of the pita bread.
Add the cucumber mixture on top of the labneh cheese.
Garnish with sliced red bell pepper and serve immediately.
Drizzle with the remaining olive oil mixture and serve.
